meaning:
1) to bear fruit
1a) (Qal) to bear fruit
1b) (Pilel) to make to flourish (fig.)

renderings.kjv: They shall still bring forth fruit

elsewhere.note: Don’t trust in oppression. Don’t become vain in robbery. If riches increase, don’t set your heart on them.
The mouth of the righteous produces wisdom, but the perverse tongue will be cut off.
For how great is his goodness, and how great is his beauty! Grain will make the young men flourish, and new wine the virgins.
